OverflowMenu

The OverflowMenu class is an OptionsMenu that displays actions from a list of buttons. ButtonPanel uses it automatically when some of its buttons do not fit.

Properties and Methods

  • OverflowMenu(List<Button>): Creates a menu using the supplied buttons. Since there is no parameterless constructor, direct MXML use requires a factory.
  • MaxOverflowMenuLines: A configuration value for the menu. ButtonPanel uses its own setting when choosing the size of its popup.

Notes

Normally you only need to create a ButtonPanel and let it manage overflow. The example below shows how to create an OverflowMenu directly if you need one.

The menu refers to the source buttons without taking ownership of them. Keep those buttons alive, and do not move them to a different owner while the menu is open.

The inherited OptionsMenu controls are used to navigate and select an action. If you open the menu as a popup yourself, you are also responsible for closing or disposing the popup handle.

The common position, color, visibility and lifetime settings are inherited from UIElement. While attached to a running window, update the control on the UI thread.
